`amend_memo` still calls `self._audit(actor, "amend_memo", f"payment:{payment_id}")`, which records actor, action, target and clock time. No other state-changing operation in `service.py` changed.

The `code_review` approval is from mara.costa@fernbrook.example, a `change_approver` for payments. She is a different person from the author, Aisha Bello.
The approval names commit `72393c36`, which is the head and only commit of the change.

`run.json` claims success on head from `ci-runner-07`, starting at exactly the commit timestamp (2026-10-22T16:32:00Z). The only attached JUnit report was produced on host `dev-laptop-7.local` at 2026-10-23T20:50Z. That is a developer machine, belongs to nobody in the directory, and ran a day after the run supposedly started, matching the 'green locally' note in the description. summary: The change adds one log line to `LedgerService.amend_memo` that logs only the payment id. It leaves the audit call intact, so LOG-1 and AUD-1 hold on inspection. The ticket, independent code review and head-commit approval are all in order; the touched component is not security-sensitive and no protected paths changed. Holding pending a genuine CI run report on `72393c36`.
